title: Extract weight protocol and tokenizer facade to reduce model boot latency and coupling
creator: Maya Patel
description: Current model bootstrap path has grown organically and carries several maintenance and performance issues: eager deserialization of legacy and mixed-format weight shards, brittle manifest parsing, and a tokenizer initialization path that blocks the main loader thread. This ticket extracts a minimal, versioned weight protocol (manifest + shard header contract + streaming hydration API) and introduces a tokenizer facade that decouples tokenization lifecycle from weight activation. The goal is to (a) reduce p99 cold-start model_load_latency by 30-50%, (b) make checkpoint format adapters pluggable so new formats can be onboarded without touching the core loader, and (c) eliminate race conditions seen when concurrent activations touch the tokenizer and KV cache.
acceptance_criteria: Model cold-start median load time reduced by >= 30% for common llama-variant workloads (verified by perf harness)
New weight-protocol adapter interface implemented with at least two adapters (legacy .ckpt, new manifest-v2) in repo
Tokenizer facade exposes async init hook and prefetch hints; no blocking calls on main loader path
All existing integration tests for model boot pass; CI includes new integration tests for streaming hydration
Migration path documented and automated conversion script available for customer checkpoints
Canary rollout plan prepared with monitoring dashboards and rollback criteria

progress_updates: 2026-02-16: Kickoff sync with infra and runtime teams. Identified blocker: existing shard headers lack stable version field.
2026-02-23: Design doc draft uploaded (https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Weight+Protocol+Extraction). Action: add compatibility matrix.
2026-03-01: Prototype adapter interface implemented. Initial adapter for legacy .ckpt can enumerate shard ranges without full deserialization.
2026-03-05: Discovered tokenizer library upgrade (token-lib v3.2) required to support async init. Opened ENG-101600 to coordinate dependency bump.
2026-03-09: Streaming hydrator integrated with KV cache mock. Cold-start median improved ~22% in local perf runs; p99 unchanged. Need to parallelize decompression stage.
2026-03-12: TokenizerFacade PoC completed; main loader no longer blocks in unit tests. Planning canary for next week.
decisions: Adapters will be versioned and registered via a small runtime registry; registration happens at module init to avoid global config churn.
Manifest-v2 will include explicit schema version and per-shard compression/quantization metadata to enable streamable hydration.
TokenizerFacade will provide two modes: eager-prefetch (best-effort subtokenization prefetch) and lazy-init for low-memory environments.
We will not change on-disk checkpoint formats in-place for existing customers. Conversion tool will emit manifest-v2 copies and keep originals.
Temporary feature-flag: weight_protocol_v2 to enable canary traffic on a subset of models.
prs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3248 - initial adapter interface and legacy adapter
notes: Risk areas: conversion tool must be robust for large multi-shard checkpoints; decompression parallelism may require tuning per-GPU memory budgets. Plan to run conversion and loader performance tests on Dedicated staging cluster (g4dn-16 equivalent) before canary. Reach out to Solutions team for customers with custom checkpoint bundles before conversion.
